messages:
Sasha (PM): Quick sync  we need to re-scope Optimize toolkit: batching, prefix caching, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts. Customers want lower token cost, <100ms P95 mobile, and faster regression detection. Proposing three lanes: Cost, Latency, Quality. Prioritize minimal launch gates by EOW. Thoughts?

Mike (Eng): +1. Split batching: server-side dynamic batching vs client/mobile heuristics. Dynamic gives big cost wins but risks tail latency.

Linda (ML): For quant, start with model profiles (fp16, q4, int8) and per-model baselines. Llama2-family + two community models to begin. Need eval harness before rollout.

Anna (Solutions): Customers ask for a "cost vs latency" slider in Console and a migration checklist for Dedicated. Also short runbooks for common customer archetypes.

Tom (SRE): Caveat: aggressive batching can spike P99. Require canary, per-route P95/P99 dashboards, token-cost telemetry, and circuit-breaker SLOs. Define rollback triggers.

Sasha (PM): Draft minimal gates: 1) Quant perf matrix for top-3 models; 2) Batching policy with SLO override + canary; 3) Eval-alerts prototype + runbook; 4) Console presets and docs. Anything missing?

Mike (Eng): Add explicit rollout metrics: token reduction %, P95/P99 ceilings, and allowed eval score delta. We'll add stop conditions.

Linda (ML): Use relative quality thresholds per-customer (e.g., generation recall drop <2%). Prefer task-specific evals + periodic human spot-checks.

Anna (Solutions): I'll map customers to lanes (AcmeHealth=accuracy-first, RetailCo=cost-first, StartupX=mobile-first) and build an impact matrix.

Tom (SRE): Rollout recipe: canary 5% -> 25% over 24h; rollback if eval-alert rate >2% or P99 delta >50ms. Add a KV-cache correctness chaos test.

deploy-bot: created epic RDW-1423 and linked PRD https://redwood.internal/epics/RDW-1423 :rocket:

Sasha (PM): Next steps: Mike+Linda to draft tech spec and bench plan by Tue EOD. Anna owns impact matrix. Tom authors SLO guardrails and rollout recipe. Prioritization workshop Wed 10am.

Mike (Eng): I'll run an experiment: q4a quant + prefix caching on 10% traffic first.

Linda (ML): Quick bench snippet I'll start with: ```bash
python bench.py --model llm-2 --quant q4 --seq 512 --batch 1 --iters 100
```

Sasha (PM): Keep updates here. Aim for <=4 clear gates so Sales/CS can set expectations. :+1:
